repair_result.repair_prompt:
你是一个 Vue 到 San 迁移修复专家。请根据 SSM、当前 San 代码和校验报告，修复 San 单文件组件。
修复目标：输出必须满足下面列出的 San 结构、语法和渲染一致性规则；不要只生成语义上看起来像 San 的代码。

输出要求：
1. 只输出完整 .san 文件内容，不要输出解释、标题或 Markdown 代码围栏。
2. 必须包含 <template>、<script>、<style> 三段。
3. <script> 中必须使用 const san = require('san')、const DataTypes = san.DataTypes、module.exports = san.defineComponent(...)。
4. Vue props 必须迁移为 San dataTypes，禁止在 san.defineComponent 中输出 props: {...}。

        "content": "\r\n.media-review-studio { max-width: 1180px; min-height: 620px; margin: 0 auto; color: #172033; background: #f5f7fa; border: 1px solid #dce1e8; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; }\r\n.studio-header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 20px 24px; background: #ffffff; border-bottom: 1px solid #dce1e8; }\r\n.studio-header h2 { margin: 3px 0 0; font-size: 21px; }\r\n.eyebrow { margin: 0; color: #657084; font-size: 12px; text-transform: uppercase; }\r\n.reviewer-stack { display: flex; }\r\n.reviewer-stack span { display: grid; width: 32px; height: 32px; margin-left: -7px; place-items: center; border: 2px solid #ffffff; border-radius: 50%; background: #264653; color: #ffffff; font-size: 12px; }\r\n.studio-layout { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 210px minmax(360px, 1fr) 320px; min-height: 550px; }\r\n.asset-rail { padding: 18px 14px; background: #ffffff; border-right: 1px solid #dce1e8; }\r\n.asset-rail h3, .note-heading h3 { margin: 0 0 14px; font-size: 14px; }\r\n.asset-item { display: grid; width: 100%; margin-bottom: 9px; padding: 11px; gap: 5px; text-align: left; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 5px; background: #f4f6f8; color: #283548; cursor: pointer; }\r\n.asset-item.active { border-color: #2a9d8f; background: #e8f5f2; }\r\n.asset-item.approved .asset-kind { color: #237a57; }\r\n.asset-kind { color: #7a8494; font-size: 11px; }\r\n.asset-item small { color: #758094; }\r\n.review-stage { display: flex; min-width: 0; padding: 22px; flex-direction: column; gap: 15px; }\r\n.media-frame { display: flex; min-height: 320px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; position: relative; overflow: hidden; background: #18222d; color: #ffffff; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #0b1118; }\r\n.media-frame.playing { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px #2a9d8f; }\r\n.frame-art { font-size: 70px; opacity: .78; }\r\n.frame-caption { display: flex; right: 16px; bottom: 14px; left: 16px; position: absolute; justify-content: space-between; color: #dfe7ee; font-size: 12px; }\r\n.transport { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 64px 1fr auto; align-items: center; gap: 12px; }\r\n.transport input { width: 100%; accent-color: #2a9d8f; }\r\n.transport output { color: #566174; font-size: 12px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }\r\n.play-button { padding: 8px 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; background: #264653; color: #ffffff; cursor: pointer; }\r\n.decision-bar { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto auto; align-items: center; padding: 13px; gap: 9px; border: 1px solid #d8dee6; background: #ffffff; }\r\n.decision-bar div { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px; }\r\n.decision-bar span { color: #707b8d; font-size: 11px; }\r\n.decision-bar button { padding: 8px 11px; border: 1px solid #c8d0da; border-radius: 4px; background: #ffffff; cursor: pointer; }\r\n.decision-bar button.chosen { border-color: #e76f51; background: #fff0ec; color: #9f3622; }\r\n.note-panel { padding: 18px; overflow: hidden; background: #ffffff; border-left: 1px solid #dce1e8; }\r\n.note-heading { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; }\r\n.filter-group { display: flex; gap: 4px; }\r\n.filter-group button { padding: 4px 7px; border: 0; border-radius: 3px; background: #edf0f4; color: #5e6878; font-size: 11px; cursor: pointer; }\r\n.filter-group button.active { background: #264653; color: #ffffff; }\r\n.note-form { display: grid; padding: 12px; gap: 8px; background: #f2f5f7; }\r\n.note-form label { color: #5a6577; font-size: 12px; }\r\n.note-form textarea { padding: 8px; resize: vertical; border: 1px solid #cbd3dc; border-radius: 3px; font: inherit; }\r\n.note-form button { justify-self: end; padding: 7px 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 3px; background: #2a9d8f; color: #ffffff; cursor: pointer; }\r\n.note-form button:disabled { opacity: .45; cursor: not-allowed; }\r\n.note-list { max-height: 350px; margin-top: 13px; overflow: auto; }\r\n.note-card { margin-bottom: 9px; padding: 11px; border-left: 3px solid #e9c46a; background: #fffaf0; }\r\n.note-card.resolved { border-left-color: #7ebc89; background: #f2faf4; opacity: .72; }\r\n.time-link { padding: 0; border: 0; background: transparent; color: #267a72; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; }\r\n.note-card p { margin: 7px 0 10px; line-height: 1.45; font-size: 13px; }\r\n.note-card footer { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; color: #697487; font-size: 11px; }\r\n.note-card footer span { margin-right: auto; }\r\n.note-card footer button { padding: 0; border: 0; background: transparent; color: #3d6470; font-size: 11px; cursor: pointer; }\r\n.note-card footer .remove-note { color: #a33d31; }\r\n.empty-notes { padding: 28px 8px; color: #818a98; text-align: center; font-size: 13px; }\r\n@media (max-width: 900px) { .studio-layout { grid-template-columns: 180px 1fr; } .note-panel { grid-column: 1 / -1; border-top: 1px solid #dce1e8; border-left: 0; } }\r\n",

<template>
<section class="media-review-studio">
    <header class="studio-header">
        <div>
            <p class="eyebrow">内容审阅</p>
            <h2>{{title}}</h2>
        </div>
        <div class="reviewer-stack">
            <span s-for="reviewer in reviewers trackby reviewer.id" title="{{reviewer.name}}">{{reviewerInitial(reviewer.name)}}</span>
        </div>
    </header>
    <div class="studio-layout">
        <aside class="asset-rail">
            <h3>媒体资产</h3>
            <button type="button" class="asset-item" s-for="asset in assets trackby asset.id" class="{{asset.id === selectedId ? 'active' : ''}} {{asset.decision === 'approved' ? 'approved' : ''}}" on-click="selectAsset(asset.id)">
                <span class="asset-kind">{{asset.kind}}</span>
                <strong>{{asset.name}}</strong>
                <small>{{formatTime(asset.duration)}} · {{asset.notes.length}} 条批注</small>
            </button>
        </aside>
        <main class="review-stage" s-if="selectedAsset">
            <div class="media-frame" class="{{isPlaying ? 'playing' : ''}}">
                <div class="frame-art">{{selectedAsset.kind === '视频' ? '▶' : '▧'}}</div>
                <div class="frame-caption">
                    <strong>{{selectedAsset.name}}</strong>
                    <span>{{isPlaying ? '正在播放' : '已暂停'}}</span>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="transport">
                <button type="button" class="play-button" on-click="togglePlayback">{{isPlaying ? '暂停' : '播放'}}</button>
                <input type="range" min="0" max="{{selectedAsset.duration}}" value="{{currentTime}}" on-input="seek" />
                <output>{{formatTime(currentTime)}} / {{formatTime(selectedAsset.duration)}}</output>
            </div>
            <div class="decision-bar">
                <div>
                    <span>审阅决定</span>
                    <strong>{{decisionText}}</strong>
                </div>
                <button type="button" class="{{selectedAsset.decision === 'changes' ? 'chosen' : ''}}" on-click="setDecision('changes')">退回修改</button>
                <button type="button" class="{{selectedAsset.decision === 'approved' ? 'chosen' : ''}}" on-click="setDecision('approved')">批准发布</button>
            </div>
        </main>
        <aside class="note-panel" s-if="selectedAsset">
            <div class="note-heading">
                <h3>时间点批注</h3>
                <div class="filter-group">
                    <button type="button" class="{{filter === 'all' ? 'active' : ''}}" on-click="setFilter('all')">全部</button>
                    <button type="button" class="{{filter === 'open' ? 'active' : ''}}" on-click="setFilter('open')">待处理</button>
                </div>
            </div>
            <form class="note-form" on-submit="addNote">
                <label>在 {{formatTime(currentTime)}} 添加批注</label>
                <textarea rows="3" placeholder="描述需要调整的画面或声音" value="{= noteText =}"></textarea>
                <button type="submit" disabled="{{!noteText}}">添加批注</button>
            </form>
            <div class="note-list">
                <article class="note-card" s-for="note in visibleNotes trackby note.id" class="{{note.resolved ? 'resolved' : ''}}">
                    <button type="button" class="time-link" on-click="jumpTo(note.time)">{{formatTime(note.time)}}</button>
                    <p>{{note.text}}</p>
                    <footer>
                        <span>{{note.author}}</span>
                        <button type="button" on-click="toggleResolved(note.id)">{{note.resolved ? '重新打开' : '标记解决'}}</button>
                        <button type="button" class="remove-note" on-click="removeNote(note.id)">删除</button>
                    </footer>
                </article>
                <p class="empty-notes" s-if="visibleNotes.length === 0">当前筛选下没有批注</p>
            </div>
        </aside>
    </div>
</section>
</template>

<script>
const san = require('san');
const DataTypes = san.DataTypes;

module.exports = san.defineComponent({
    name: 'MediaReviewStudio',

    dataTypes: {
        title: DataTypes.string,
        reviewers: DataTypes.array,
        initialAssets: DataTypes.array
    },

    initData() {
        return {
            assets: [],
            selectedId: null,
            currentTime: 0,
            isPlaying: false,
            noteText: '',
            filter: 'all',
            timer: null
        };
    },

    inited() {
        const initialAssets = this.data.get('initialAssets') || [];
        this.data.set('assets', this.cloneAssets(initialAssets));
        this.data.set('selectedId', initialAssets.length ? initialAssets[0].id : null);
    },

    attached() {
        this.data.set('timer', setInterval(() => this.tick(), 1000));
    },

    disposed() {
        const timer = this.data.get('timer');
        if (timer) {
            clearInterval(timer);
        }
    },

    cloneAssets(assets) {
        return assets.map((asset) => Object.assign({}, asset, {
            notes: asset.notes.map((note) => Object.assign({}, note))
        }));
    },

    selectAsset(id) {
        this.data.set('selectedId', id);
        this.data.set('currentTime', 0);
        this.data.set('isPlaying', false);
        this.data.set('filter', 'all');
    },

    togglePlayback() {
        const selectedAsset = this.data.get('selectedAsset');
        if (!selectedAsset) return;
        const currentTime = this.data.get('currentTime');
        if (currentTime >= selectedAsset.duration) {
            this.data.set('currentTime', 0);
        }
        this.data.set('isPlaying', !this.data.get('isPlaying'));
    },

    tick() {
        const isPlaying = this.data.get('isPlaying');
        const selectedAsset = this.data.get('selectedAsset');
        if (!isPlaying || !selectedAsset) return;
        const currentTime = this.data.get('currentTime');
        const newTime = Math.min(currentTime + 1, selectedAsset.duration);
        this.data.set('currentTime', newTime);
        if (newTime >= selectedAsset.duration) {
            this.data.set('isPlaying', false);
        }
    },

    seek(event) {
        this.data.set('currentTime', Number(event.target.value));
    },

    jumpTo(time) {
        this.data.set('currentTime', time);
        this.data.set('isPlaying', false);
    },

    addNote() {
        const text = (this.data.get('noteText') || '').trim();
        const selectedAsset = this.data.get('selectedAsset');
        if (!text || !selectedAsset) return;
        const currentTime = this.data.get('currentTime');
        const reviewers = this.data.get('reviewers') || [];
        const author = reviewers.length ? reviewers[0].name : '审阅者';
        const note = {
            id: Date.now(),
            time: currentTime,
            text,
            author,
            resolved: false
        };
        const notes = selectedAsset.notes || [];
        notes.push(note);
        this.data.set('noteText', '');
        this.data.set('filter', 'all');
    },

    toggleResolved(id) {
        const selectedAsset = this.data.get('selectedAsset');
        if (!selectedAsset) return;
        const note = (selectedAsset.notes || []).find((item) => item.id === id);
        if (note) {
            note.resolved = !note.resolved;
        }
    },

    removeNote(id) {
        const selectedAsset = this.data.get('selectedAsset');
        if (!selectedAsset) return;
        const notes = (selectedAsset.notes || []).filter((note) => note.id !== id);
        selectedAsset.notes = notes;
    },

    setFilter(filter) {
        this.data.set('filter', filter);
    },

    setDecision(decision) {
        const selectedAsset = this.data.get('selectedAsset');
        if (!selectedAsset) return;
        selectedAsset.decision = decision;
        this.fire('review-decision', {
            assetId: this.data.get('selectedId'),
            decision
        });
    },

    reviewerInitial(name) {
        return String(name || '').slice(0, 1);
    },

    formatTime(value) {
        const seconds = Math.max(0, Number(value) || 0);
        const minutes = Math.floor(seconds / 60);
        return minutes + ':' + String(seconds % 60).padStart(2, '0');
    },

    computed: {
        selectedAsset() {
            const assets = this.data.get('assets') || [];
            const selectedId = this.data.get('selectedId');
            return assets.find((asset) => asset.id === selectedId) || null;
        },

        visibleNotes() {
            const selectedAsset = this.data.get('selectedAsset');
            if (!selectedAsset) return [];
            const filter = this.data.get('filter');
            if (filter === 'open') {
                return (selectedAsset.notes || []).filter((note) => !note.resolved);
            }
            return selectedAsset.notes || [];
        },

        decisionText() {
            const labels = { pending: '等待决定', changes: '需要修改', approved: '可以发布' };
            const selectedAsset = this.data.get('selectedAsset');
            return selectedAsset ? labels[selectedAsset.decision] : '';
        }
    }
});
</script>

san_generation_contract.description: 约束大模型基于本 schema 生成 San 组件时必须满足的条件。
must_preserve: metadata.component_name 和根节点语义
template.dom_tree 的层级结构、节点顺序与语义角色
template.component_refs 中每个子组件的注册名和父子通信事件
binding_graph 中 data/props/computed 到模板节点的可见绑定
event_model 中每个 DOM 事件和自定义事件的触发时机与 payload
style_model 中动态类名、动态样式、scoped CSS 和关键视觉状态
script.options.lifecycle_hooks 中的副作用初始化与清理逻辑
script.options.data 中所有字段的默认值和外部初始化来源
quality_checks: template.component_refs 中每个子组件都在 script.components 或 san_registration 中有定义
binding_graph.edges 中每条 template 依赖都能在 script.options 中找到来源
event_model.dom_events 中每个 handler_name 都存在于 script.options.methods
event_model.custom_events 中每个 emit_points 都对应 method 中的 $emit 调用
style_model.dynamic_class_bindings 的 dependencies 都存在于 binding_graph.nodes
script.options.watch 中的 deep watcher 在 migration_hints 中被标记并给出替代策略
san_syntax_requirements: 输出完整的 .san 单文件组件，包含 <template>、<script>、<style> 三个代码块；若无样式也保留空 style 或显式说明无样式
脚本块显式引入 san：const san = require('san')，并使用 module.exports = san.defineComponent(...) 导出组件
props 使用 san.DataTypes 声明，与 script.options.props 一一对应；优先输出 DataTypes.number / string / bool / array / object
组件定义使用 san.defineComponent
组件名来自 metadata.component_name，并显式输出 name 字段
data 使用 initData 返回默认值，与 script.options.data 一一对应；不要在 initData 中直接依赖复杂运行时读取
当 data 字段来源于 props 或外部初始化时，优先在 inited/attached 中用 this.data.set 完成同步
模板中使用 s-if、s-for、on-event、value={= =}、checked={= =} 等 San 语法
状态访问统一使用 this.data.get() / this.data.set()
优先将 methods 直接定义在组件对象顶层，避免保留 Vue 风格的 methods: {} 包裹
子组件标签使用短横线命名
子组件在 components 中显式注册
样式块需尽量完整输出，优先复用 styles/style_model 中已有 class 与 css_rules 信息
定时器、timeout、外部监听等副作用在 attached/disposed 中管理

repair_result.repair_prompt:
你是一个 Vue 到 San 迁移修复专家。请根据 SSM、当前 San 代码和校验报告，修复 San 单文件组件。
修复目标：输出必须满足下面列出的 San 结构、语法和渲染一致性规则；不要只生成语义上看起来像 San 的代码。

输出要求：
1. 只输出完整 .san 文件内容，不要输出解释、标题或 Markdown 代码围栏。
2. 必须包含 <template>、<script>、<style> 三段。
3. <script> 中必须使用 const san = require('san')、const DataTypes = san.DataTypes、module.exports = san.defineComponent(...)。
4. Vue props 必须迁移为 San dataTypes，禁止在 san.defineComponent 中输出 props: {...}。
5. initData() 只能返回稳定默认数据对象；Vue props 的 default（包括数组/对象工厂默认值）必须作为同名字段落入 initData；Vue data() 的全部初始值必须精确等价地保留，包括嵌套对象、数组、数字和启用项集合，不得用空字符串、空数组或删减后的集合替代；如果内部 data 依赖 props，必须在 inited() 中用 this.data.get('propName') 读取并 this.data.set(...) 同步。
6. 组件状态读写必须使用 this.data.get('field') 和 this.data.set('field', value)；San computed 的结果也在 data store 中，computed 之间的依赖以及普通方法读取 computed 时必须使用 this.data.get('computedName')，禁止 this.computed.foo()；Vue 的 this.$emit(...) 或 emitEvent 包装方法必须迁移为 this.fire(...)，禁止 this.props、this.xxx 状态读写、this.$emit 和用 this.dispatch(...) 代替自定义事件。

        "content": "\r\n.media-review-studio { max-width: 1180px; min-height: 620px; margin: 0 auto; color: #172033; background: #f5f7fa; border: 1px solid #dce1e8; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; }\r\n.studio-header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 20px 24px; background: #ffffff; border-bottom: 1px solid #dce1e8; }\r\n.studio-header h2 { margin: 3px 0 0; font-size: 21px; }\r\n.eyebrow { margin: 0; color: #657084; font-size: 12px; text-transform: uppercase; }\r\n.reviewer-stack { display: flex; }\r\n.reviewer-stack span { display: grid; width: 32px; height: 32px; margin-left: -7px; place-items: center; border: 2px solid #ffffff; border-radius: 50%; background: #264653; color: #ffffff; font-size: 12px; }\r\n.studio-layout { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 210px minmax(360px, 1fr) 320px; min-height: 550px; }\r\n.asset-rail { padding: 18px 14px; background: #ffffff; border-right: 1px solid #dce1e8; }\r\n.asset-rail h3, .note-heading h3 { margin: 0 0 14px; font-size: 14px; }\r\n.asset-item { display: grid; width: 100%; margin-bottom: 9px; padding: 11px; gap: 5px; text-align: left; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 5px; background: #f4f6f8; color: #283548; cursor: pointer; }\r\n.asset-item.active { border-color: #2a9d8f; background: #e8f5f2; }\r\n.asset-item.approved .asset-kind { color: #237a57; }\r\n.asset-kind { color: #7a8494; font-size: 11px; }\r\n.asset-item small { color: #758094; }\r\n.review-stage { display: flex; min-width: 0; padding: 22px; flex-direction: column; gap: 15px; }\r\n.media-frame { display: flex; min-height: 320px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; position: relative; overflow: hidden; background: #18222d; color: #ffffff; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #0b1118; }\r\n.media-frame.playing { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px #2a9d8f; }\r\n.frame-art { font-size: 70px; opacity: .78; }\r\n.frame-caption { display: flex; right: 16px; bottom: 14px; left: 16px; position: absolute; justify-content: space-between; color: #dfe7ee; font-size: 12px; }\r\n.transport { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 64px 1fr auto; align-items: center; gap: 12px; }\r\n.transport input { width: 100%; accent-color: #2a9d8f; }\r\n.transport output { color: #566174; font-size: 12px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }\r\n.play-button { padding: 8px 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; background: #264653; color: #ffffff; cursor: pointer; }\r\n.decision-bar { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto auto; align-items: center; padding: 13px; gap: 9px; border: 1px solid #d8dee6; background: #ffffff; }\r\n.decision-bar div { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px; }\r\n.decision-bar span { color: #707b8d; font-size: 11px; }\r\n.decision-bar button { padding: 8px 11px; border: 1px solid #c8d0da; border-radius: 4px; background: #ffffff; cursor: pointer; }\r\n.decision-bar button.chosen { border-color: #e76f51; background: #fff0ec; color: #9f3622; }\r\n.note-panel { padding: 18px; overflow: hidden; background: #ffffff; border-left: 1px solid #dce1e8; }\r\n.note-heading { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; }\r\n.filter-group { display: flex; gap: 4px; }\r\n.filter-group button { padding: 4px 7px; border: 0; border-radius: 3px; background: #edf0f4; color: #5e6878; font-size: 11px; cursor: pointer; }\r\n.filter-group button.active { background: #264653; color: #ffffff; }\r\n.note-form { display: grid; padding: 12px; gap: 8px; background: #f2f5f7; }\r\n.note-form label { color: #5a6577; font-size: 12px; }\r\n.note-form textarea { padding: 8px; resize: vertical; border: 1px solid #cbd3dc; border-radius: 3px; font: inherit; }\r\n.note-form button { justify-self: end; padding: 7px 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 3px; background: #2a9d8f; color: #ffffff; cursor: pointer; }\r\n.note-form button:disabled { opacity: .45; cursor: not-allowed; }\r\n.note-list { max-height: 350px; margin-top: 13px; overflow: auto; }\r\n.note-card { margin-bottom: 9px; padding: 11px; border-left: 3px solid #e9c46a; background: #fffaf0; }\r\n.note-card.resolved { border-left-color: #7ebc89; background: #f2faf4; opacity: .72; }\r\n.time-link { padding: 0; border: 0; background: transparent; color: #267a72; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; }\r\n.note-card p { margin: 7px 0 10px; line-height: 1.45; font-size: 13px; }\r\n.note-card footer { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; color: #697487; font-size: 11px; }\r\n.note-card footer span { margin-right: auto; }\r\n.note-card footer button { padding: 0; border: 0; background: transparent; color: #3d6470; font-size: 11px; cursor: pointer; }\r\n.note-card footer .remove-note { color: #a33d31; }\r\n.empty-notes { padding: 28px 8px; color: #818a98; text-align: center; font-size: 13px; }\r\n@media (max-width: 900px) { .studio-layout { grid-template-columns: 180px 1fr; } .note-panel { grid-column: 1 / -1; border-top: 1px solid #dce1e8; border-left: 0; } }\r\n",

<template>
<section class="media-review-studio">
    <header class="studio-header">
        <div>
            <p class="eyebrow">内容审阅</p>
            <h2>{{title}}</h2>
        </div>
        <div class="reviewer-stack">
            <span s-for="reviewer in reviewers trackby reviewer.id" title="{{reviewer.name}}">{{reviewerInitial(reviewer.name)}}</span>
        </div>
    </header>
    <div class="studio-layout">
        <aside class="asset-rail">
            <h3>媒体资产</h3>
            <button type="button" class="asset-item" s-for="asset in assets trackby asset.id" class="{{asset.id === selectedId ? 'active' : ''}} {{asset.decision === 'approved' ? 'approved' : ''}}" on-click="selectAsset(asset.id)">
                <span class="asset-kind">{{asset.kind}}</span>
                <strong>{{asset.name}}</strong>
                <small>{{formatTime(asset.duration)}} · {{asset.notes.length}} 条批注</small>
            </button>
        </aside>
        <main class="review-stage" s-if="selectedAsset">
            <div class="media-frame" class="{{isPlaying ? 'playing' : ''}}">
                <div class="frame-art">{{selectedAsset.kind === '视频' ? '▶' : '▧'}}</div>
                <div class="frame-caption">
                    <strong>{{selectedAsset.name}}</strong>
                    <span>{{isPlaying ? '正在播放' : '已暂停'}}</span>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="transport">
                <button type="button" class="play-button" on-click="togglePlayback">{{isPlaying ? '暂停' : '播放'}}</button>
                <input type="range" min="0" max="{{selectedAsset.duration}}" value="{{currentTime}}" on-input="seek" />
                <output>{{formatTime(currentTime)}} / {{formatTime(selectedAsset.duration)}}</output>
            </div>
            <div class="decision-bar">
                <div>
                    <span>审阅决定</span>
                    <strong>{{decisionText}}</strong>
                </div>
                <button type="button" class="{{selectedAsset.decision === 'changes' ? 'chosen' : ''}}" on-click="setDecision('changes')">退回修改</button>
                <button type="button" class="{{selectedAsset.decision === 'approved' ? 'chosen' : ''}}" on-click="setDecision('approved')">批准发布</button>
            </div>
        </main>
        <aside class="note-panel" s-if="selectedAsset">
            <div class="note-heading">
                <h3>时间点批注</h3>
                <div class="filter-group">
                    <button type="button" class="{{filter === 'all' ? 'active' : ''}}" on-click="setFilter('all')">全部</button>
                    <button type="button" class="{{filter === 'open' ? 'active' : ''}}" on-click="setFilter('open')">待处理</button>
                </div>
            </div>
            <form class="note-form" on-submit="addNote">
                <label>在 {{formatTime(currentTime)}} 添加批注</label>
                <textarea rows="3" placeholder="描述需要调整的画面或声音" value="{= noteText =}"></textarea>
                <button type="submit" disabled="{{!noteText}}">添加批注</button>
            </form>
            <div class="note-list">
                <article class="note-card" s-for="note in visibleNotes trackby note.id" class="{{note.resolved ? 'resolved' : ''}}">
                    <button type="button" class="time-link" on-click="jumpTo(note.time)">{{formatTime(note.time)}}</button>
                    <p>{{note.text}}</p>
                    <footer>
                        <span>{{note.author}}</span>
                        <button type="button" on-click="toggleResolved(note.id)">{{note.resolved ? '重新打开' : '标记解决'}}</button>
                        <button type="button" class="remove-note" on-click="removeNote(note.id)">删除</button>
                    </footer>
                </article>
                <p class="empty-notes" s-if="visibleNotes.length === 0">当前筛选下没有批注</p>
            </div>
        </aside>
    </div>
</section>
</template>

<script>
const san = require('san');
const DataTypes = san.DataTypes;

module.exports = san.defineComponent({
    name: 'MediaReviewStudio',

    dataTypes: {
        title: DataTypes.string,
        reviewers: DataTypes.array,
        initialAssets: DataTypes.array
    },

    initData() {
        return {
            title: '秋季发布片审阅',
            reviewers: [
                { id: 1, name: '林晓' },
                { id: 2, name: '周宁' },
                { id: 3, name: '陈一' }
            ],
            initialAssets: [
                {
                    id: 1,
                    name: '品牌开场动画',
                    kind: '视频',
                    duration: 96,
                    decision: 'pending',
                    notes: [
                        { id: 11, time: 18, text: '徽标出现节奏可以再快半秒。', author: '林晓', resolved: false },
                        { id: 12, time: 64, text: '环境音已经通过版权核验。', author: '周宁', resolved: true }
                    ]
                },
                {
                    id: 2,
                    name: '产品功能演示',
                    kind: '视频',
                    duration: 143,
                    decision: 'changes',
                    notes: [{ id: 21, time: 37, text: '此处操作路径与最新版不一致。', author: '陈一', resolved: false }]
                },
                { id: 3, name: '片尾封面', kind: '图片', duration: 12, decision: 'approved', notes: [] }
            ],
            assets: [],
            selectedId: null,
            currentTime: 0,
            isPlaying: false,
            noteText: '',
            filter: 'all',
            timer: null
        };
    },

    inited() {
        const initialAssets = this.data.get('initialAssets') || [];
        this.data.set('assets', this.cloneAssets(initialAssets));
        this.data.set('selectedId', initialAssets.length ? initialAssets[0].id : null);
    },

    attached() {
        this.data.set('timer', setInterval(() => this.tick(), 1000));
    },

    disposed() {
        const timer = this.data.get('timer');
        if (timer) {
            clearInterval(timer);
        }
    },

    cloneAssets(assets) {
        return assets.map((asset) => Object.assign({}, asset, {
            notes: asset.notes.map((note) => Object.assign({}, note))
        }));
    },

    selectAsset(id) {
        this.data.set('selectedId', id);
        this.data.set('currentTime', 0);
        this.data.set('isPlaying', false);
        this.data.set('filter', 'all');
    },

    togglePlayback() {
        const selectedAsset = this.data.get('selectedAsset');
        if (!selectedAsset) return;
        const currentTime = this.data.get('currentTime');
        if (currentTime >= selectedAsset.duration) {
            this.data.set('currentTime', 0);
        }
        this.data.set('isPlaying', !this.data.get('isPlaying'));
    },

    tick() {
        const isPlaying = this.data.get('isPlaying');
        const selectedAsset = this.data.get('selectedAsset');
        if (!isPlaying || !selectedAsset) return;
        const currentTime = this.data.get('currentTime');
        const newTime = Math.min(currentTime + 1, selectedAsset.duration);
        this.data.set('currentTime', newTime);
        if (newTime >= selectedAsset.duration) {
            this.data.set('isPlaying', false);
        }
    },

    seek(event) {
        this.data.set('currentTime', Number(event.target.value));
    },

    jumpTo(time) {
        this.data.set('currentTime', time);
        this.data.set('isPlaying', false);
    },

    addNote() {
        const text = (this.data.get('noteText') || '').trim();
        const selectedAsset = this.data.get('selectedAsset');
        if (!text || !selectedAsset) return;
        const currentTime = this.data.get('currentTime');
        const reviewers = this.data.get('reviewers') || [];
        const author = reviewers.length ? reviewers[0].name : '审阅者';
        const note = {
            id: Date.now(),
            time: currentTime,
            text,
            author,
            resolved: false
        };
        const notes = selectedAsset.notes || [];
        notes.push(note);
        this.data.set('noteText', '');
        this.data.set('filter', 'all');
    },

    toggleResolved(id) {
        const selectedAsset = this.data.get('selectedAsset');
        if (!selectedAsset) return;
        const note = (selectedAsset.notes || []).find((item) => item.id === id);
        if (note) {
            note.resolved = !note.resolved;
        }
    },

    removeNote(id) {
        const selectedAsset = this.data.get('selectedAsset');
        if (!selectedAsset) return;
        const notes = (selectedAsset.notes || []).filter((note) => note.id !== id);
        selectedAsset.notes = notes;
    },

    setFilter(filter) {
        this.data.set('filter', filter);
    },

    setDecision(decision) {
        const selectedAsset = this.data.get('selectedAsset');
        if (!selectedAsset) return;
        selectedAsset.decision = decision;
        this.fire('review-decision', {
            assetId: this.data.get('selectedId'),
            decision
        });
    },

    reviewerInitial(name) {
        return String(name || '').slice(0, 1);
    },

    formatTime(value) {
        const seconds = Math.max(0, Number(value) || 0);
        const minutes = Math.floor(seconds / 60);
        return minutes + ':' + String(seconds % 60).padStart(2, '0');
    },

    computed: {
        selectedAsset() {
            const assets = this.data.get('assets') || [];
            const selectedId = this.data.get('selectedId');
            return assets.find((asset) => asset.id === selectedId) || null;
        },

        visibleNotes() {
            const selectedAsset = this.data.get('selectedAsset');
            if (!selectedAsset) return [];
            const filter = this.data.get('filter');
            if (filter === 'open') {
                return (selectedAsset.notes || []).filter((note) => !note.resolved);
            }
            return selectedAsset.notes || [];
        },

        decisionText() {
            const labels = { pending: '等待决定', changes: '需要修改', approved: '可以发布' };
            const selectedAsset = this.data.get('selectedAsset');
            return selectedAsset ? labels[selectedAsset.decision] : '';
        }
    }
});
</script>

san_generation_contract.description: 约束大模型基于本 schema 生成 San 组件时必须满足的条件。
must_preserve: metadata.component_name 和根节点语义
template.dom_tree 的层级结构、节点顺序与语义角色
template.component_refs 中每个子组件的注册名和父子通信事件
binding_graph 中 data/props/computed 到模板节点的可见绑定
event_model 中每个 DOM 事件和自定义事件的触发时机与 payload
style_model 中动态类名、动态样式、scoped CSS 和关键视觉状态
script.options.lifecycle_hooks 中的副作用初始化与清理逻辑
script.options.data 中所有字段的默认值和外部初始化来源
quality_checks: template.component_refs 中每个子组件都在 script.components 或 san_registration 中有定义
binding_graph.edges 中每条 template 依赖都能在 script.options 中找到来源
event_model.dom_events 中每个 handler_name 都存在于 script.options.methods
event_model.custom_events 中每个 emit_points 都对应 method 中的 $emit 调用
style_model.dynamic_class_bindings 的 dependencies 都存在于 binding_graph.nodes
script.options.watch 中的 deep watcher 在 migration_hints 中被标记并给出替代策略
san_syntax_requirements: 输出完整的 .san 单文件组件，包含 <template>、<script>、<style> 三个代码块；若无样式也保留空 style 或显式说明无样式
脚本块显式引入 san：const san = require('san')，并使用 module.exports = san.defineComponent(...) 导出组件
props 使用 san.DataTypes 声明，与 script.options.props 一一对应；优先输出 DataTypes.number / string / bool / array / object
组件定义使用 san.defineComponent
组件名来自 metadata.component_name，并显式输出 name 字段
data 使用 initData 返回默认值，与 script.options.data 一一对应；不要在 initData 中直接依赖复杂运行时读取
当 data 字段来源于 props 或外部初始化时，优先在 inited/attached 中用 this.data.set 完成同步
模板中使用 s-if、s-for、on-event、value={= =}、checked={= =} 等 San 语法
状态访问统一使用 this.data.get() / this.data.set()
优先将 methods 直接定义在组件对象顶层，避免保留 Vue 风格的 methods: {} 包裹
子组件标签使用短横线命名
子组件在 components 中显式注册
样式块需尽量完整输出，优先复用 styles/style_model 中已有 class 与 css_rules 信息
定时器、timeout、外部监听等副作用在 attached/disposed 中管理

state.repair_prompt:
你是一个 Vue 到 San 迁移修复专家。请根据 SSM、当前 San 代码和校验报告，修复 San 单文件组件。
修复目标：输出必须满足下面列出的 San 结构、语法和渲染一致性规则；不要只生成语义上看起来像 San 的代码。

输出要求：
1. 只输出完整 .san 文件内容，不要输出解释、标题或 Markdown 代码围栏。
2. 必须包含 <template>、<script>、<style> 三段。
3. <script> 中必须使用 const san = require('san')、const DataTypes = san.DataTypes、module.exports = san.defineComponent(...)。
4. Vue props 必须迁移为 San dataTypes，禁止在 san.defineComponent 中输出 props: {...}。
5. initData() 只能返回稳定默认数据对象；Vue props 的 default（包括数组/对象工厂默认值）必须作为同名字段落入 initData；Vue data() 的全部初始值必须精确等价地保留，包括嵌套对象、数组、数字和启用项集合，不得用空字符串、空数组或删减后的集合替代；如果内部 data 依赖 props，必须在 inited() 中用 this.data.get('propName') 读取并 this.data.set(...) 同步。
6. 组件状态读写必须使用 this.data.get('field') 和 this.data.set('field', value)；San computed 的结果也在 data store 中，computed 之间的依赖以及普通方法读取 computed 时必须使用 this.data.get('computedName')，禁止 this.computed.foo()；Vue 的 this.$emit(...) 或 emitEvent 包装方法必须迁移为 this.fire(...)，禁止 this.props、this.xxx 状态读写、this.$emit 和用 this.dispatch(...) 代替自定义事件。
7. 方法必须直接定义在 san.defineComponent 顶层，禁止保留 Vue 的 methods: {...} 包裹。
8. template 必须使用 San 语法：on-click、s-if、s-for；保留事件调用的全部参数，例如 on-click="move(-1)"、on-click="select(task.id)"；Vue v-for 的 :key 必须写入 s-for 的 trackby 子句，例如 s-for="task in tasks trackby task.id"，禁止输出独立 key="{{ task.id }}" 或 key="{= task.id =}"；所有 {{ ... }} 和 {= ... =} 插值必须完整闭合；双向绑定 {= assignable.path =} 只能用于可赋值的数据路径，方法调用、computed 表达式和其他派生值必须使用单向插值；disabled、checked、selected 等派生属性必须使用 disabled="{{ expression }}" 这一类单向插值，禁止写成 disabled="{= expression =}"；方法调用、computed 表达式和其他派生值必须使用单向插值，例如 checked="{{ isEnabled(rule.id, enabled) }}"；禁止丢失参数、使用 data-args/getAttribute 绕行，或保留 @click、v-if、v-for、v-model、:class 等 Vue 模板语法。
9. style 标签必须写成 <style>，禁止输出 <style scoped>；必须保留原有 class 名和样式内容。
10. 不要重新设计组件，不要引入外部依赖，不要删除已有 DOM 节点、文本、class 或样式。
11. 如果 DOM 对比报告指出缺失/新增/变化节点，优先修复 template 结构。
12. 补充要求：优先修复 validate 与 visual_eval 报告中指出的问题，保持原有 DOM 结构、文本、class 和样式。

修复前请按下面清单自检，但最终不要输出清单：
- 是否存在 props:、methods:、this.props、this.$emit、this.dispatch、<style scoped>、@click、v-if、v-for、v-model、:class？如果存在，必须改掉。
- SSM props 是否全部出现在 dataTypes 中？
- 带 default 的 Vue props 是否以同名字段和等价默认值出现在 initData 中？
- Vue data() 中每个初始值是否精确保留了原始类型、嵌套内容、数组元素和数值，而不是空值或删减值？
- computed 之间以及普通方法中是否只通过 this.data.get('computedName') 读取 computed，且完全不存在 this.computed.foo()？
- 所有 {= ... =} 是否都是可赋值数据路径；disabled、checked、selected 等派生属性是否使用 {{ ... }} 单向插值；方法调用和 computed 等派生表达式是否使用 {{ ... }} 单向插值？
- 所有 {{ ... }} 和 {= ... =} 是否完整闭合；Vue v-for 的 :key 是否迁移为 s-for 内联 trackby，且不存在独立 key 属性？
- 事件绑定中的参数是否完整保留，且没有 data-args/getAttribute 绕行？
- SSM data 字段是否全部在 initData 或 this.data.set 中有对应？
- SSM 事件 handler 是否同时在 template 的 on-* 和 script 顶层方法中存在？

        "content": "\r\n.media-review-studio { max-width: 1180px; min-height: 620px; margin: 0 auto; color: #172033; background: #f5f7fa; border: 1px solid #dce1e8; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; }\r\n.studio-header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 20px 24px; background: #ffffff; border-bottom: 1px solid #dce1e8; }\r\n.studio-header h2 { margin: 3px 0 0; font-size: 21px; }\r\n.eyebrow { margin: 0; color: #657084; font-size: 12px; text-transform: uppercase; }\r\n.reviewer-stack { display: flex; }\r\n.reviewer-stack span { display: grid; width: 32px; height: 32px; margin-left: -7px; place-items: center; border: 2px solid #ffffff; border-radius: 50%; background: #264653; color: #ffffff; font-size: 12px; }\r\n.studio-layout { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 210px minmax(360px, 1fr) 320px; min-height: 550px; }\r\n.asset-rail { padding: 18px 14px; background: #ffffff; border-right: 1px solid #dce1e8; }\r\n.asset-rail h3, .note-heading h3 { margin: 0 0 14px; font-size: 14px; }\r\n.asset-item { display: grid; width: 100%; margin-bottom: 9px; padding: 11px; gap: 5px; text-align: left; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 5px; background: #f4f6f8; color: #283548; cursor: pointer; }\r\n.asset-item.active { border-color: #2a9d8f; background: #e8f5f2; }\r\n.asset-item.approved .asset-kind { color: #237a57; }\r\n.asset-kind { color: #7a8494; font-size: 11px; }\r\n.asset-item small { color: #758094; }\r\n.review-stage { display: flex; min-width: 0; padding: 22px; flex-direction: column; gap: 15px; }\r\n.media-frame { display: flex; min-height: 320px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; position: relative; overflow: hidden; background: #18222d; color: #ffffff; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #0b1118; }\r\n.media-frame.playing { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px #2a9d8f; }\r\n.frame-art { font-size: 70px; opacity: .78; }\r\n.frame-caption { display: flex; right: 16px; bottom: 14px; left: 16px; position: absolute; justify-content: space-between; color: #dfe7ee; font-size: 12px; }\r\n.transport { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 64px 1fr auto; align-items: center; gap: 12px; }\r\n.transport input { width: 100%; accent-color: #2a9d8f; }\r\n.transport output { color: #566174; font-size: 12px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }\r\n.play-button { padding: 8px 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; background: #264653; color: #ffffff; cursor: pointer; }\r\n.decision-bar { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto auto; align-items: center; padding: 13px; gap: 9px; border: 1px solid #d8dee6; background: #ffffff; }\r\n.decision-bar div { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px; }\r\n.decision-bar span { color: #707b8d; font-size: 11px; }\r\n.decision-bar button { padding: 8px 11px; border: 1px solid #c8d0da; border-radius: 4px; background: #ffffff; cursor: pointer; }\r\n.decision-bar button.chosen { border-color: #e76f51; background: #fff0ec; color: #9f3622; }\r\n.note-panel { padding: 18px; overflow: hidden; background: #ffffff; border-left: 1px solid #dce1e8; }\r\n.note-heading { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; }\r\n.filter-group { display: flex; gap: 4px; }\r\n.filter-group button { padding: 4px 7px; border: 0; border-radius: 3px; background: #edf0f4; color: #5e6878; font-size: 11px; cursor: pointer; }\r\n.filter-group button.active { background: #264653; color: #ffffff; }\r\n.note-form { display: grid; padding: 12px; gap: 8px; background: #f2f5f7; }\r\n.note-form label { color: #5a6577; font-size: 12px; }\r\n.note-form textarea { padding: 8px; resize: vertical; border: 1px solid #cbd3dc; border-radius: 3px; font: inherit; }\r\n.note-form button { justify-self: end; padding: 7px 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 3px; background: #2a9d8f; color: #ffffff; cursor: pointer; }\r\n.note-form button:disabled { opacity: .45; cursor: not-allowed; }\r\n.note-list { max-height: 350px; margin-top: 13px; overflow: auto; }\r\n.note-card { margin-bottom: 9px; padding: 11px; border-left: 3px solid #e9c46a; background: #fffaf0; }\r\n.note-card.resolved { border-left-color: #7ebc89; background: #f2faf4; opacity: .72; }\r\n.time-link { padding: 0; border: 0; background: transparent; color: #267a72; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; }\r\n.note-card p { margin: 7px 0 10px; line-height: 1.45; font-size: 13px; }\r\n.note-card footer { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; color: #697487; font-size: 11px; }\r\n.note-card footer span { margin-right: auto; }\r\n.note-card footer button { padding: 0; border: 0; background: transparent; color: #3d6470; font-size: 11px; cursor: pointer; }\r\n.note-card footer .remove-note { color: #a33d31; }\r\n.empty-notes { padding: 28px 8px; color: #818a98; text-align: center; font-size: 13px; }\r\n@media (max-width: 900px) { .studio-layout { grid-template-columns: 180px 1fr; } .note-panel { grid-column: 1 / -1; border-top: 1px solid #dce1e8; <template>
<section class="media-review-studio">
    <header class="studio-header">
        <div>
            <p class="eyebrow">内容审阅</p>
            <h2>{{title}}</h2>
        </div>
        <div class="reviewer-stack">
            <span s-for="reviewer in reviewers trackby reviewer.id" title="{{reviewer.name}}">{{reviewerInitial(reviewer.name)}}</span>
        </div>
    </header>
    <div class="studio-layout">
        <aside class="asset-rail">
            <h3>媒体资产</h3>
            <button type="button" class="asset-item" s-for="asset in assets trackby asset.id" class="{{asset.id === selectedId ? 'active' : ''}} {{asset.decision === 'approved' ? 'approved' : ''}}" on-click="selectAsset(asset.id)">
                <span class="asset-kind">{{asset.kind}}</span>
                <strong>{{asset.name}}</strong>
                <small>{{formatTime(asset.duration)}} · {{asset.notes.length}} 条批注</small>
            </button>
        </aside>
        <main class="review-stage" s-if="selectedAsset">
            <div class="media-frame" class="{{isPlaying ? 'playing' : ''}}">
                <div class="frame-art">{{selectedAsset.kind === '视频' ? '▶' : '▧'}}</div>
                <div class="frame-caption">
                    <strong>{{selectedAsset.name}}</strong>
                    <span>{{isPlaying ? '正在播放' : '已暂停'}}</span>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="transport">
                <button type="button" class="play-button" on-click="togglePlayback">{{isPlaying ? '暂停' : '播放'}}</button>
                <input type="range" min="0" max="{{selectedAsset.duration}}" value="{{currentTime}}" on-input="seek" />
                <output>{{formatTime(currentTime)}} / {{formatTime(selectedAsset.duration)}}</output>
            </div>
            <div class="decision-bar">
                <div>
                    <span>审阅决定</span>
                    <strong>{{decisionText}}</strong>
                </div>
                <button type="button" class="{{selectedAsset.decision === 'changes' ? 'chosen' : ''}}" on-click="setDecision('changes')">退回修改</button>
                <button type="button" class="{{selectedAsset.decision === 'approved' ? 'chosen' : ''}}" on-click="setDecision('approved')">批准发布</button>
            </div>
        </main>
        <aside class="note-panel" s-if="selectedAsset">
            <div class="note-heading">
                <h3>时间点批注</h3>
                <div class="filter-group">
                    <button type="button" class="{{filter === 'all' ? 'active' : ''}}" on-click="setFilter('all')">全部</button>
                    <button type="button" class="{{filter === 'open' ? 'active' : ''}}" on-click="setFilter('open')">待处理</button>
                </div>
            </div>
            <form class="note-form" on-submit="addNote">
                <label>在 {{formatTime(currentTime)}} 添加批注</label>
                <textarea rows="3" placeholder="描述需要调整的画面或声音" value="{= noteText =}"></textarea>
                <button type="submit" disabled="{{!noteText}}">添加批注</button>
            </form>
            <div class="note-list">
                <article class="note-card" s-for="note in visibleNotes trackby note.id" class="{{note.resolved ? 'resolved' : ''}}">
                    <button type="button" class="time-link" on-click="jumpTo(note.time)">{{formatTime(note.time)}}</button>
                    <p>{{note.text}}</p>
                    <footer>
                        <span>{{note.author}}</span>
                        <button type="button" on-click="toggleResolved(note.id)">{{note.resolved ? '重新打开' : '标记解决'}}</button>
                        <button type="button" class="remove-note" on-click="removeNote(note.id)">删除</button>
                    </footer>
                </article>
                <p class="empty-notes" s-if="visibleNotes.length === 0">当前筛选下没有批注</p>
            </div>
        </aside>
    </div>
</section>

<script>
const san = require('san');
const DataTypes = san.DataTypes;

module.exports = san.defineComponent({
    name: 'MediaReviewStudio',

    dataTypes: {
        title: DataTypes.string,
        reviewers: DataTypes.array,
        initialAssets: DataTypes.array
    },

    initData() {
        return {
            title: '秋季发布片审阅',
            reviewers: [
                { id: 1, name: '林晓' },
                { id: 2, name: '周宁' },
                { id: 3, name: '陈一' }
            ],
            initialAssets: [
                {
                    id: 1,
                    name: '品牌开场动画',
                    kind: '视频',
                    duration: 96,
                    decision: 'pending',
                    notes: [
                        { id: 11, time: 18, text: '徽标出现节奏可以再快半秒。', author: '林晓', resolved: false },
                        { id: 12, time: 64, text: '环境音已经通过版权核验。', author: '周宁', resolved: true }
                    ]
                },
                {
                    id: 2,
                    name: '产品功能演示',
                    kind: '视频',
                    duration: 143,
                    decision: 'changes',
                    notes: [{ id: 21, time: 37, text: '此处操作路径与最新版不一致。', author: '陈一', resolved: false }]
                },
                { id: 3, name: '片尾封面', kind: '图片', duration: 12, decision: 'approved', notes: [] }
            ],
            assets: [],
            selectedId: null,
            currentTime: 0,
            isPlaying: false,
            noteText: '',
            filter: 'all',
            timer: null
        };
    },

    inited() {
        const initialAssets = this.data.get('initialAssets') || [];
        this.data.set('assets', this.cloneAssets(initialAssets));
        this.data.set('selectedId', initialAssets.length ? initialAssets[0].id : null);
    },

    attached() {
        this.data.set('timer', setInterval(() => this.tick(), 1000));
    },

    disposed() {
        const timer = this.data.get('timer');
        if (timer) {
            clearInterval(timer);
        }
    },

    cloneAssets(assets) {
        return assets.map((asset) => Object.assign({}, asset, {
            notes: asset.notes.map((note) => Object.assign({}, note))
        }));
    },

    selectAsset(id) {
        this.data.set('selectedId', id);
        this.data.set('currentTime', 0);
        this.data.set('isPlaying', false);
        this.data.set('filter', 'all');
    },

    togglePlayback() {
        const selectedAsset = this.data.get('selectedAsset');
        if (!selectedAsset) return;
        const currentTime = this.data.get('currentTime');
        if (currentTime >= selectedAsset.duration) {
            this.data.set('currentTime', 0);
        }
        this.data.set('isPlaying', !this.data.get('isPlaying'));
    },

    tick() {
        const isPlaying = this.data.get('isPlaying');
        const selectedAsset = this.data.get('selectedAsset');
        if (!isPlaying || !selectedAsset) return;
        const currentTime = this.data.get('currentTime');
        const newTime = Math.min(currentTime + 1, selectedAsset.duration);
        this.data.set('currentTime', newTime);
        if (newTime >= selectedAsset.duration) {
            this.data.set('isPlaying', false);
        }
    },

    seek(event) {
        this.data.set('currentTime', Number(event.target.value));
    },

    jumpTo(time) {
        this.data.set('currentTime', time);
        this.data.set('isPlaying', false);
    },

    addNote() {
        const text = (this.data.get('noteText') || '').trim();
        const selectedAsset = this.data.get('selectedAsset');
        if (!text || !selectedAsset) return;
        const currentTime = this.data.get('currentTime');
        const reviewers = this.data.get('reviewers') || [];
        const author = reviewers.length ? reviewers[0].name : '审阅者';
        const note = {
            id: Date.now(),
            time: currentTime,
            text,
            author,
            resolved: false
        };
        const notes = selectedAsset.notes || [];
        notes.push(note);
        this.data.set('noteText', '');
        this.data.set('filter', 'all');
    },

    toggleResolved(id) {
        const selectedAsset = this.data.get('selectedAsset');
        if (!selectedAsset) return;
        const note = (selectedAsset.notes || []).find((item) => item.id === id);
        if (note) {
            note.resolved = !note.resolved;
        }
    },

    removeNote(id) {
        const selectedAsset = this.data.get('selectedAsset');
        if (!selectedAsset) return;
        const notes = (selectedAsset.notes || []).filter((note) => note.id !== id);
        selectedAsset.notes = notes;
    },

    setFilter(filter) {
        this.data.set('filter', filter);
    },

    setDecision(decision) {
        const selectedAsset = this.data.get('selectedAsset');
        if (!selectedAsset) return;
        selectedAsset.decision = decision;
        this.fire('review-decision', {
            assetId: this.data.get('selectedId'),
            decision
        });
    },

    reviewerInitial(name) {
        return String(name || '').slice(0, 1);
    },

    formatTime(value) {
        const seconds = Math.max(0, Number(value) || 0);
        const minutes = Math.floor(seconds / 60);
        return minutes + ':' + String(seconds % 60).padStart(2, '0');
    },

    computed: {
        selectedAsset() {
            const assets = this.data.get('assets') || [];
            const selectedId = this.data.get('selectedId');
            return assets.find((asset) => asset.id === selectedId) || null;
        },

        visibleNotes() {
            const selectedAsset = this.data.get('selectedAsset');
            if (!selectedAsset) return [];
            const filter = this.data.get('filter');
            if (filter === 'open') {
                return (selectedAsset.notes || []).filter((note) => !note.resolved);
            }
            return selectedAsset.notes || [];
        },

        decisionText() {
            const labels = { pending: '等待决定', changes: '需要修改', approved: '可以发布' };
            const selectedAsset = this.data.get('selectedAsset');
            return selectedAsset ? labels[selectedAsset.decision] : '';
        }
    }
});
</script>

must_preserve: metadata.component_name 和根节点语义

template.component_refs 中每个子组件的注册名和父子通信事件
binding_graph 中 data/props/computed 到模板节点的可见绑定
event_model 中每个 DOM 事件和自定义事件的触发时机与 payload
style_model 中动态类名、动态样式、scoped CSS 和关键视觉状态

props 使用 san.DataTypes 声明，与 script.options.props 一一对应；优先输出 DataTypes.number / string / bool / array / object
组件定义使用 san.defineComponent
组件名来自 metadata.component_name，并显式输出 name 字段
data 使用 initData 返回默认值，与 script.options.data 一一对应；不要在 initData 中直接依赖复杂运行时读取
当 data 字段来源于 props 或外部初始化时，优先在 inited/attached 中用 this.data.set 完成同步
模板中使用 s-if、s-for、on-event、value={= =}、checked={= =} 等 San 语法

优先将 methods 直接定义在组件对象顶层，避免保留 Vue 风格的 methods: {} 包裹
子组件标签使用短横线命名
子组件在 components 中显式注册
样式块需尽量完整输出，优先复用 styles/style_model 中已有 class 与 css_rules 信息
定时器、timeout、外部监听等副作用在 attached/disposed 中管理

repair_result.repair_prompt:
你是一个 Vue 到 San 迁移修复专家。请根据 SSM、当前 San 代码和校验报告，修复 San 单文件组件。
修复目标：输出必须满足下面列出的 San 结构、语法和渲染一致性规则；不要只生成语义上看起来像 San 的代码。

输出要求：
1. 只输出完整 .san 文件内容，不要输出解释、标题或 Markdown 代码围栏。
2. 必须包含 <template>、<script>、<style> 三段。
3. <script> 中必须使用 const san = require('san')、const DataTypes = san.DataTypes、module.exports = san.defineComponent(...)。
4. Vue props 必须迁移为 San dataTypes，禁止在 san.defineComponent 中输出 props: {...}。
5. initData() 只能返回稳定默认数据对象；Vue props 的 default（包括数组/对象工厂默认值）必须作为同名字段落入 initData；Vue data() 的全部初始值必须精确等价地保留，包括嵌套对象、数组、数字和启用项集合，不得用空字符串、空数组或删减后的集合替代；如果内部 data 依赖 props，必须在 inited() 中用 this.data.get('propName') 读取并 this.data.set(...) 同步。
6. 组件状态读写必须使用 this.data.get('field') 和 this.data.set('field', value)；San computed 的结果也在 data store 中，computed 之间的依赖以及普通方法读取 computed 时必须使用 this.data.get('computedName')，禁止 this.computed.foo()；Vue 的 this.$emit(...) 或 emitEvent 包装方法必须迁移为 this.fire(...)，禁止 this.props、this.xxx 状态读写、this.$emit 和用 this.dispatch(...) 代替自定义事件。
7. 方法必须直接定义在 san.defineComponent 顶层，禁止保留 Vue 的 methods: {...} 包裹。
8. template 必须使用 San 语法：on-click、s-if、s-for；保留事件调用的全部参数，例如 on-click="move(-1)"、on-click="select(task.id)"；Vue v-for 的 :key 必须写入 s-for 的 trackby 子句，例如 s-for="task in tasks trackby task.id"，禁止输出独立 key="{{ task.id }}" 或 key="{= task.id =}"；所有 {{ ... }} 和 {= ... =} 插值必须完整闭合；双向绑定 {= assignable.path =} 只能用于可赋值的数据路径，方法调用、computed 表达式和其他派生值必须使用单向插值；disabled、checked、selected 等派生属性必须使用 disabled="{{ expression }}" 这一类单向插值，禁止写成 disabled="{= expression =}"；方法调用、computed 表达式和其他派生值必须使用单向插值，例如 checked="{{ isEnabled(rule.id, enabled) }}"；禁止丢失参数、使用 data-args/getAttribute 绕行，或保留 @click、v-if、v-for、v-model、:class 等 Vue 模板语法。
9. style 标签必须写成 <style>，禁止输出 <style scoped>；必须保留原有 class 名和样式内容。
10. 不要重新设计组件，不要引入外部依赖，不要删除已有 DOM 节点、文本、class 或样式。
11. 如果 DOM 对比报告指出缺失/新增/变化节点，优先修复 template 结构。
12. 补充要求：优先修复 validate 与 visual_eval 报告中指出的问题，保持原有 DOM 结构、文本、class 和样式。

修复前请按下面清单自检，但最终不要输出清单：
- 是否存在 props:、methods:、this.props、this.$emit、this.dispatch、<style scoped>、@click、v-if、v-for、v-model、:class？如果存在，必须改掉。
- SSM props 是否全部出现在 dataTypes 中？
- 带 default 的 Vue props 是否以同名字段和等价默认值出现在 initData 中？
- Vue data() 中每个初始值是否精确保留了原始类型、嵌套内容、数组元素和数值，而不是空值或删减值？
- computed 之间以及普通方法中是否只通过 this.data.get('computedName') 读取 computed，且完全不存在 this.computed.foo()？
- 所有 {= ... =} 是否都是可赋值数据路径；disabled、checked、selected 等派生属性是否使用 {{ ... }} 单向插值；方法调用和 computed 等派生表达式是否使用 {{ ... }} 单向插值？
- 所有 {{ ... }} 和 {= ... =} 是否完整闭合；Vue v-for 的 :key 是否迁移为 s-for 内联 trackby，且不存在独立 key 属性？
- 事件绑定中的参数是否完整保留，且没有 data-args/getAttribute 绕行？
- SSM data 字段是否全部在 initData 或 this.data.set 中有对应？
- SSM 事件 handler 是否同时在 template 的 on-* 和 script 顶层方法中存在？

<template>
<section class="media-review-studio">
    <header class="studio-header">
        <div>
            <p class="eyebrow">内容审阅</p>
            <h2>{{title}}</h2>
        </div>
        <div class="reviewer-stack">
            <span s-for="reviewer in reviewers trackby reviewer.id" title="{{reviewer.name}}">{{reviewerInitial(reviewer.name)}}</span>
        </div>
    </header>
    <div class="studio-layout">
        <aside class="asset-rail">
            <h3>媒体资产</h3>
            <button type="button" class="asset-item" s-for="asset in assets trackby asset.id" class="{{asset.id === selectedId ? 'active' : ''}} {{asset.decision === 'approved' ? 'approved' : ''}}" on-click="selectAsset(asset.id)">
                <span class="asset-kind">{{asset.kind}}</span>
                <strong>{{asset.name}}</strong>
                <small>{{formatTime(asset.duration)}} · {{asset.notes.length}} 条批注</small>
            </button>
        </aside>
        <main class="review-stage" s-if="selectedAsset">
            <div class="media-frame" class="{{isPlaying ? 'playing' : ''}}">
                <div class="frame-art">{{selectedAsset.kind === '视频' ? '▶' : '▧'}}</div>
                <div class="frame-caption">
                    <strong>{{selectedAsset.name}}</strong>
                    <span>{{isPlaying ? '正在播放' : '已暂停'}}</span>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="transport">
                <button type="button" class="play-button" on-click="togglePlayback">{{isPlaying ? '暂停' : '播放'}}</button>
                <input type="range" min="0" max="{{selectedAsset.duration}}" value="{{currentTime}}" on-input="seek" />
                <output>{{formatTime(currentTime)}} / {{formatTime(selectedAsset.duration)}}</output>
            </div>
            <div class="decision-bar">
                <div>
                    <span>审阅决定</span>
                    <strong>{{decisionText}}</strong>
                </div>
                <button type="button" class="{{selectedAsset.decision === 'changes' ? 'chosen' : ''}}" on-click="setDecision('changes')">退回修改</button>
                <button type="button" class="{{selectedAsset.decision === 'approved' ? 'chosen' : ''}}" on-click="setDecision('approved')">批准发布</button>
            </div>
        </main>
        <aside class="note-panel" s-if="selectedAsset">
            <div class="note-heading">

                    <button type="button" class="{{filter === 'open' ? 'active' : ''}}" on-click="setFilter('open')">待处理</button>

                <textarea rows="3" placeholder="描述需要调整的画面或声音" value="{= noteText =}"></textarea>
                <button type="submit" disabled="{{!noteText}}">添加批注</button>

            <div class="note-list">
                <article class="note-card" s-for="note in visibleNotes trackby note.id" class="{{note.resolved ? 'resolved' : ''}}">

                    <p>{{note.text}}</p>
                    <footer>
                        <span>{{note.author}}</span>
                        <button type="button" on-click="toggleResolved(note.id)">{{note.resolved ? '重新打开' : '标记解决'}}</button>
                        <button type="button" class="remove-note" on-click="removeNote(note.id)">删除</button>

<script>
const san = require('san');
const DataTypes = san.DataTypes;

module.exports = san.defineComponent({
    name: 'MediaReviewStudio',

    dataTypes: {
        title: DataTypes.string,
        reviewers: DataTypes.array,
        initialAssets: DataTypes.array
    },

    initData() {
        return {
            title: '秋季发布片审阅',
            reviewers: [
                { id: 1, name: '林晓' },
                { id: 2, name: '周宁' },
                { id: 3, name: '陈一' }
            ],
            initialAssets: [
                {
                    id: 1,
                    name: '品牌开场动画',
                    kind: '视频',
                    duration: 96,
                    decision: 'pending',
                    notes: [
                        { id: 11, time: 18, text: '徽标出现节奏可以再快半秒。', author: '林晓', resolved: false },
                        { id: 12, time: 64, text: '环境音已经通过版权核验。', author: '周宁', resolved: true }
                    ]
                },
                {
                    id: 2,
                    name: '产品功能演示',
                    kind: '视频',
                    duration: 143,
                    decision: 'changes',
                    notes: [{ id: 21, time: 37, text: '此处操作路径与最新版不一致。', author: '陈一', resolved: false }]
                },
                { id: 3, name: '片尾封面', kind: '图片', duration: 12, decision: 'approved', notes: [] }
            ],
            assets: [],
            selectedId: null,
            currentTime: 0,
            isPlaying: false,
            noteText: '',
            filter: 'all',
            timer: null
        };
    },

    inited() {
        const initialAssets = this.data.get('initialAssets') || [];
        this.data.set('assets', this.cloneAssets(initialAssets));
        this.data.set('selectedId', initialAssets.length ? initialAssets[0].id : null);
    },

    attached() {
        this.data.set('timer', setInterval(() => this.tick(), 1000));
    },

    disposed() {
        const timer = this.data.get('timer');
        if (timer) {
            clearInterval(timer);
        }
    },

    cloneAssets(assets) {
        return assets.map((asset) => Object.assign({}, asset, {
            notes: asset.notes.map((note) => Object.assign({}, note))
        }));
    },

    selectAsset(id) {
        this.data.set('selectedId', id);
        this.data.set('currentTime', 0);
        this.data.set('isPlaying', false);
        this.data.set('filter', 'all');
    },

    togglePlayback() {
        const selectedAsset = this.data.get('selectedAsset');
        if (!selectedAsset) return;
        const currentTime = this.data.get('currentTime');
        if (currentTime >= selectedAsset.duration) {
            this.data.set('currentTime', 0);
        }
        this.data.set('isPlaying', !this.data.get('isPlaying'));
    },

    tick() {
        const isPlaying = this.data.get('isPlaying');
        const selectedAsset = this.data.get('selectedAsset');
        if (!isPlaying || !selectedAsset) return;
        const currentTime = this.data.get('currentTime');
        const newTime = Math.min(currentTime + 1, selectedAsset.duration);
        this.data.set('currentTime', newTime);
        if (newTime >= selectedAsset.duration) {
            this.data.set('isPlaying', false);
        }
    },

    seek(event) {
        this.data.set('currentTime', Number(event.target.value));
    },

    jumpTo(time) {
        this.data.set('currentTime', time);
        this.data.set('isPlaying', false);
    },

    addNote() {
        const text = (this.data.get('noteText') || '').trim();
        const selectedAsset = this.data.get('selectedAsset');
        if (!text || !selectedAsset) return;
        const currentTime = this.data.get('currentTime');
        const reviewers = this.data.get('reviewers') || [];
        const author = reviewers.length ? reviewers[0].name : '审阅者';
        const note = {
            id: Date.now(),
            time: currentTime,
            text,
            author,
            resolved: false
        };
        const notes = selectedAsset.notes || [];
        notes.push(note);
        this.data.set('noteText', '');
        this.data.set('filter', 'all');
    },

    toggleResolved(id) {
        const selectedAsset = this.data.get('selectedAsset');
        if (!selectedAsset) return;
        const note = (selectedAsset.notes || []).find((item) => item.id === id);
        if (note) {
            note.resolved = !note.resolved;
        }
    },

    removeNote(id) {
        const selectedAsset = this.data.get('selectedAsset');
        if (!selectedAsset) return;
        const notes = (selectedAsset.notes || []).filter((note) => note.id !== id);
        selectedAsset.notes = notes;
    },

    setFilter(filter) {
        this.data.set('filter', filter);
    },

    setDecision(decision) {
        const selectedAsset = this.data.get('selectedAsset');
        if (!selectedAsset) return;
        selectedAsset.decision = decision;
        this.fire('review-decision', {
            assetId: this.data.get('selectedId'),
            decision
        });
    },

    reviewerInitial(name) {
        return String(name || '').slice(0, 1);
    },

    formatTime(value) {
        const seconds = Math.max(0, Number(value) || 0);
        const minutes = Math.floor(seconds / 60);
        return minutes + ':' + String(seconds % 60).padStart(2, '0');
    },

    computed: {
        selectedAsset() {
            const assets = this.data.get('assets') || [];
            const selectedId = this.data.get('selectedId');
            return assets.find((asset) => asset.id === selectedId) || null;
        },

        visibleNotes() {
            const selectedAsset = this.data.get('selectedAsset');
            if (!selectedAsset) return [];
            const filter = this.data.get('filter');
            if (filter === 'open') {
                return (selectedAsset.notes || []).filter((note) => !note.resolved);
            }
            return selectedAsset.notes || [];
        },

        decisionText() {
            const labels = { pending: '等待决定', changes: '需要修改', approved: '可以发布' };
            const selectedAsset = this.data.get('selectedAsset');
            return selectedAsset ? labels[selectedAsset.decision] : '';
        }
    }
});
</script>
